title: Step 6 — BCCR burns 8,000,000 fCeBM on Besu and mints 8,000,000 tCeBM on Paladin
description: Two chains move, so two transaction hashes come back: the Besu burn of the fiat token and the Zeto/Paladin mint of the privacy token.
notes: Gateway: BCCR Central Bank gateway (spoke-crc). The approve/reject/exchange half of the reserve lifecycle is registered only on a Central Bank gateway and is gated to ROLE_TREASURY; a commercial-bank gateway answers 404 on this path. Field divergence, verified in the delivered gateway (ApproveEscrowResult): the Paladin-side hash is named mint_tx_hash, not the zeto_mint_tx_hash declared by the Scenario A OpenAPI document and by contracts/pvp. Scenario B's contract has this right; Scenario A's document does not describe its own gateway.
